groups.context: Follow the challenge to pirate leadership and the account of growing up with his father's crew.

records.Japanese:
くっ、また負けたか…
だが、今度こそ………はっ！
records.current_English:
Damn, I lost again...
 But next time... Huh?!

records.Japanese:
悪いが
あんたにゃ『今度』はねえんだ
records.current_English:
Sorry, but you ain't getting 
 a next time.

records.Japanese: くっくっくっ
records.current_English: Heh heh...

records.Japanese: なんだって！？　もう一度言ってみな！
records.current_English: What?! Say that again!

records.Japanese: ああ？　聞こえなかったか？
records.current_English: Huh? Didn't hear me?

records.Japanese:
あんたの言うことを聞くヤツなんざ
ここにゃ、誰もいねえってことよ！
records.current_English:
There's nobody left here who'll
 take orders from you!

records.Japanese:
…ちきしょう！
てめえら、裏切ったね！！
records.current_English: Damn you! You betrayed me!

records.Japanese: 向こうが騒がしいようだが…
records.current_English: There's a commotion over there...

records.Japanese:
くだんの女海賊を
配下が取り囲んでおるようですぞ
records.current_English:
That pirate's own men seem 
 to have surrounded her.

records.Japanese: …船を近づけろ
records.current_English: ...Bring us closer.

records.Japanese:
ここんとこ、負け続けでちっとも金が
増えやしねえ。あんたには、その責任を
とってもらわねえと
records.current_English:
We keep losing.
 Our pockets are empty. 
 You're gonna answer for it.

records.Japanese: 責任だと…
records.current_English: Answer?!

records.Japanese:
だいたい
なぜFOを
追いかけ回すんですかい？
records.current_English:
Why are we chasing 
 FO
 all over, anyway?

records.Japanese:
へっ、みんなに言えない
理由があるんだろ？！
records.current_English:
Heh. Got a reason you can't tell 
 the rest of us, huh?!

records.Japanese:
あんたの魂胆は
FOから
『血塗られたシャムシール』を
取り戻したいだけなんだ
親父の形見だもんな！
records.current_English:
You just want
 the Bloodstained Shamshir back 
 from FO.
 A keepsake from your old man!

records.Japanese: それは…そんなつもりじゃ…
records.current_English: That's... That wasn't what I...

records.Japanese:
最近のあんたは、なってなかったぜ
金も稼げねえ頭についていく物好きは
いねえよ。覚悟しな！
records.current_English:
You've been slipping. Who's
 gonna follow a captain who 
 can't make them any money? 
 You've got this coming!

records.Japanese:
提督！
このまま放っておけば
あの女、殺されますぞ！
records.current_English:
Admiral! If we do nothing, 
 they'll kill her!

records.Japanese: …見捨てるわけにもいくまい
records.current_English: We cannot abandon her.

records.Japanese: じゃ、行くぞ
records.current_English: Then I'm going in.

records.Japanese: お、おい、早まるでない！
records.current_English: W-wait! Don't do anything rash!

records.Japanese:
なんだあ？
よそ者は引っ込んでな！
records.current_English: Huh? Stay out of this, outsider!

records.Japanese: …下っ端が図に乗るな
records.current_English:
...Don't get cocky,
 you two-bit thug.

records.Japanese:
てめえにゃ関係ねえ！
…この際だ、アズィーザもこいつも
まとめて片付けろ！
records.current_English:
None of your business! 
 While we're at it, let's get rid 
 of Aziza and this guy!

records.Japanese: アル殿、助太刀いたす
records.current_English: Al, I will lend you my blade.

records.Japanese:
あたしもやる！
数を頼むしかない男なんて、最低よ！
records.current_English:
Count me in! Men who have to gang
 up on someone are the worst!

records.Japanese:
ああいう奴らは、景気よくドカーンと
吹き飛ばしましょうか
records.current_English:
Why don't we send them flying
 with a good, loud bang?

records.Japanese:
…海賊ども！
さあ来い、やってやる！
records.current_English: Pirates! Come and face me!

records.Japanese:
どうして…？　なんで、アタシのために
戦ってるんだよ…
さっきまで敵だったのに…
records.current_English:
Why...? Why fight for me?
 We were enemies moments ago...

records.Japanese: く、くそっ、これじゃ分が悪いぜ！
records.current_English: D-damn! We're outmatched!

records.Japanese: ようやく気づいたか
records.current_English: Finally noticed, have you?

records.Japanese: FI・FA…
records.current_English: FI FA...

records.Japanese: …あんたもこの女を助けに来たのか？
records.current_English: You came to save her too?

records.Japanese: そうだと言ったら？
records.current_English: What if I did?

records.Japanese:
ちっ、この女が全部悪いってのに
なんで俺たちがこんな目に…
records.current_English:
Tch. This is all her fault. How'd
 we end up in this mess?

records.Japanese:
…そろそろ、愚痴も言い飽きただろう
もう彼女を解放してはどうだ
records.current_English:
Had enough of complaining? 
 Why don't you let her go?

records.Japanese:
アズィーザがいなくなれば
それでいいのだろう？
records.current_English: You just want Aziza gone, right?

records.Japanese:
聞こえてたのか
もう、誰もこの女にはついていかねえ
records.current_English:
So you heard.
 Nobody follows her now.

records.Japanese:
ならば
アズィーザは俺たちが引き取ろう
records.current_English: Then we'll take Aziza with us.

records.Japanese:
そうかい
だからって、タダでくれてやるわけにゃ
いかねえな
records.current_English:
Fine.
 We ain't letting her go for free.

records.Japanese: 金を取るだと！？
records.current_English: Money?!

records.Japanese:
アル、よせ
で、いくらで手を打つ？
records.current_English: Al, leave it. How much do you want?
One million gold.

records.Japanese: アズィーザ…来い
records.current_English: Aziza... come.

records.Japanese: 用は済んだな。あばよ！
records.current_English: That settles it. So long!

records.Japanese:
まさか、仲間に裏切られるとは
アタシも落ちたもんだよ…
それより、どうしてアタシを
助けたんだ？
records.current_English:
Never thought my own crew
 would turn on me. I've really sunk 
 low... Anyway, why'd you save me?

records.Japanese: 放っておけなかった…
records.current_English: I couldn't leave you there...

records.Japanese:
あの状況で助けないというのは
よほど非人道的な輩だぞ
records.current_English:
Anyone who'd leave you there 
 would have to be heartless.

records.Japanese:
拙者、気になっておったのだが…
そなたほどの者、なぜ海賊などに
身を落としているのだ？
records.current_English:
I've been wondering... Why 
 would someone with your skill
 turn to piracy?

records.Japanese:
買いかぶってくれるね
…身を落としたわけじゃないよ
アタシは海賊の娘。父さんが
海賊なんだ
records.current_English:
You think too highly of me.
 I didn't fall into piracy. 
 I'm a pirate's daughter. 
 My father was one.

records.Japanese: ほう
records.current_English: Oh?

records.Japanese:
さっきの海賊どもは、父さんの手下
子供のころから、見よう見まねで
剣術を覚え
海賊稼業を学んだのさ
records.current_English:
Those pirates
 were my father's crew. I grew up 
 copying them, learning swordplay 
 and the pirate trade.

records.Japanese: 父上はどうされているのだ？
records.current_English: Where is your father?

records.Japanese:
事故で死んだ
…例の剣は父さんの宝物だったのさ
父さんと一緒に消えたけど…
records.current_English:
He died in an accident.
 ...That sword was his treasure.
 It disappeared with him...

records.Japanese:
その剣が
『血塗られたシャムシール』…
records.current_English: The Bloodstained Shamshir...

records.Japanese:
アタシは父さんのような偉大な海賊に
なりたかった
父さんのことはなんでもまねした…
records.current_English:
I wanted to be a great pirate, just
 like him. I copied everything
 he did...

records.Japanese:
だから、あんたたちがこの剣を
持ってるって知ったとき、どうしても
手に入れたくなったんだ
そうすれば…
records.current_English:
When I heard you had his sword,
 I had to get it back. I thought...

records.Japanese:
そうすれば、父さんに近づいた証に
なるって…
ふふっ、だけどね
records.current_English:
I thought it would prove 
 I was a little more like him.
 Heh... But you know what?

records.Japanese:
偉大な海賊になるより、ホントは
父さんの形見が欲しかっただけ
なんだって
気が付いちゃってさ…
records.current_English:
I realized I didn't really want
 to be a great pirate.
 I just wanted something
 to remember my father by...

records.Japanese:
こんなんじゃ、見捨てられて当然ね
金にならない物を追いかけてたんだから
仲間が怒るのも無理ないか
records.current_English:
No wonder they turned on me. 
 I was chasing something
 that wouldn't make them any money. 
 I can't blame them for being angry.

records.Japanese: …まだ海賊に未練があるのか
records.current_English: ...Do you still want to be a pirate?

records.Japanese:
アタシが追っていたのは海賊じゃ
なくて、父さんだったんだもの
もう、足を洗うつもりさ
records.current_English:
I was chasing my father, not a life
 of piracy. I'm done with it.

records.Japanese: 提督…
records.current_English: Sir...

records.Japanese:
アル、言いたいことは分かっている
アズィーザ、俺の船に乗るか？
records.current_English:
I know what you want to say, Al. 
 Aziza, will you sail with us?

records.Japanese:
ありがたいね…
…アタシ、ガンガン働くよ
なんたってアンタは命の恩人だからね
records.current_English:
I'd be grateful. 
 I'll work my heart out.
 I owe you my life, after all.

records.Japanese:
それから、アタシのことは
アズィーザでいいわ
records.current_English: And from now on, just call me Aziza.

records.Japanese:
恩人に忠義を尽くすのも
ひとつの生き方でござる
records.current_English: Serving a savior is a worthy path.

records.Japanese: また賑やかになる…
records.current_English:
Things are going to get
 even livelier...
